text:
```yaml
name: Format Check

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust@v1
        with:
          rust-version: stable

      - name: Run cargo fmt
        run: cargo fmt -- --check
```
